data.name: Marriott Port-au-Prince Hotel
data.description:
A 13-minute walk from the National Museum of Haiti, this upscale hotel is also 2 km from the Musée du Panthéon National Haïtien and 7 km from Port-au-Prince International Airport.
Featuring Haitian artwork, the airy rooms offer free Wi-Fi, iPod docks and flat-screen TVs, along with safes, minifridges, and desks with ergonomic chairs. Suites add separate living rooms. Room service is available.
Parking is free. There's a hip creole bar and a sleek international restaurant with a terrace; breakfast is offered for a fee. Additional amenities include a casual cafe/deli, a gym, and an outdoor pool with a sundeck. There's also a business center.
